rules.build:
# The setup.py files take the version from the environment. export AELTRA_DISTRO_TOOLS_VERSION="1.18.0"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
for PROJECT in ffi-libarchive misc distro-info package repository image-gen; do ( cd $PROJECT bh_python_install --build ) done
rules.install:
PYTHON="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/python3"
# The setup.py files take the version from the environment. export AELTRA_DISTRO_TOOLS_VERSION="1.18.0"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
for PROJECT in ffi-libarchive misc distro-info package repository image-gen; do mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$PROJECT"
( cd $PROJECT bh_python_install \ --install \ --root "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$PROJECT" )
if [ `ls "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$PROJECT/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/" | wc -l` -gt 0 ]; then sed -i "s|^#!/usr/bin/env python.*|#!$PYTHON|g" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$PROJECT/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/"* fi done
